table_assessment.assessment_notes: Isolated guideline-summary table with twenty-four normative rows spanning arrhythmias, implanted devices, congenital heart disease, and pregnancy. It mixes medication-related and non-medication instructions and substantially duplicates disease-specific tables, so it is not an independent table example.

header_path: Recommendations for exercise and sports participation in individuals with paroxysmal supraventricular tachycardia and pre-excitation

normative_assertions.notes: All exclusion targets are retained within the assessment span.

text_units.verbatim_text: In individuals with palpitations, a comprehensive assessment to exclude (latent) pre-excitation, structural heart disease, and VAs is recommended.

competitive and recreational athletes with pre-excitation and documented arrhythmias

header_path: Recommendations for exercise and sports participation in individuals with paroxysmal supraventricular tachycardia and pre-excitation

normative_assertions.notes: Ablation recommendation.

text_units.verbatim_text: Ablation of the accessory pathway is recommended in competitive and recreational athletes with pre-excitation and documented arrhythmias.

an EP study
risk for sudden death

header_path: Recommendations for exercise and sports participation in individuals with paroxysmal supraventricular tachycardia and pre-excitation

normative_assertions.notes: Sudden-death risk evaluation is the stated purpose.

text_units.verbatim_text: In competitive/professional athletes with asymptomatic pre-excitation, an EP study is recommended to evaluate the risk for sudden death.

entities.surface_form: exercising individuals with \geq 2 PVCs on a baseline ECG (or \geq 1 PVC in case of high-endurance athletes)
a thorough evaluation (including a detailed family history) to exclude underlying structural or arrhythmogenic conditions

header_path: Exercise recommendations in individuals with premature ventricular contractions or non-sustained ventricular tachycardia

normative_assertions.notes: Alternative PVC thresholds and source-visible math are retained.

text_units.verbatim_text: In exercising individuals with \geq 2 PVCs on a baseline ECG (or \geq 1 PVC in case of high-endurance athletes) a thorough evaluation (including a detailed family history) to exclude underlying structural or arrhythmogenic conditions is recommended.

entities.surface_form: individuals with frequent PVCs and non-sustained VT
a thorough investigation with Holter monitoring, 12-lead ECG, exercise test, and suitable imaging

header_path: Exercise recommendations in individuals with premature ventricular contractions or non-sustained ventricular tachycardia

normative_assertions.notes: All named investigation components are retained.

text_units.verbatim_text: Among individuals with frequent PVCs and non-sustained VT a thorough investigation with Holter monitoring, 12-lead ECG, exercise test, and suitable imaging is recommended.

entities.surface_form: all exercising individuals with LQTS with prior symptoms or prolonged QTc
therapy with beta-blockers at target dose

header_path: Exercise recommendations in long QT syndrome

normative_assertions.notes: Target-dose beta-blocker therapy recommendation.

text_units.verbatim_text: It is recommended that all exercising individuals with LQTS with prior symptoms or prolonged QTc be on therapy with beta-blockers at target dose.

entities.surface_form: exercising individuals with LQTS
avoid QT-prolonging drugs (www.crediblemeds.org) and electrolyte imbalance such as hypokalaemia and hypomagnesaemia

header_path: Exercise recommendations in long QT syndrome

normative_assertions.notes: Compound medication and electrolyte-imbalance avoidance instruction is preserved as one exact target span.

text_units.verbatim_text: It is recommended that exercising individuals with LQTS should avoid QT-prolonging drugs (www.crediblemeds.org) and electrolyte imbalance such as hypokalaemia and hypomagnesaemia.

entities.surface_form: Participation in high-intensity recreational and competitive sports, even when on beta-blockers
individuals with a QTc > 500 ms or a genetically confirmed LQTS with a QTc \geq 470 ms in males or \geq 480 ms in females

header_path: Exercise recommendations in long QT syndrome

normative_assertions.notes: All sex-specific QTc thresholds and exact source-visible math text are retained.

text_units.verbatim_text: Participation in high-intensity recreational and competitive sports, even when on beta-blockers, is not recommended in individuals with a QTc > 500 ms or a genetically confirmed LQTS with a QTc \geq 470 ms in males or \geq 480 ms in females.

entities.surface_form: Participation in competitive sports (with or without ICD)
individuals with LQTS and prior cardiac arrest or arrhythmic syncope

header_path: Exercise recommendations in long QT syndrome

normative_assertions.notes: ICD presence does not alter the against recommendation.

text_units.verbatim_text: Participation in competitive sports (with or without ICD) is not recommended in individuals with LQTS and prior cardiac arrest or arrhythmic syncope.

entities.surface_form: ICD implantation
patients with BrS with episodes of arrhythmic syncope and/or aborted SCD

normative_assertions.notes: ICD implantation recommendation.

text_units.verbatim_text: ICD implantation is recommended in patients with BrS with episodes of arrhythmic syncope and/or aborted SCD.

entities.surface_form: Prescription of drugs that may aggravate BrS, electrolyte abnormalities, and sports practices that increase core temperature > 39^\circ\text{C}
individuals with overt BrS or phenotypically negative mutation carriers

normative_assertions.notes: Compound drug, electrolyte, and temperature-raising sports instruction is preserved without converting it into a factual relation.

text_units.verbatim_text: Prescription of drugs that may aggravate BrS, electrolyte abnormalities, and sports practices that increase core temperature > 39^\circ\text{C} are not recommended in individuals with overt BrS or phenotypically negative mutation carriers.

entities.surface_form: individuals with implanted devices with/without resynchronization and underlying disease
follow the recommendations pertaining to the underlying disease

header_path: Exercise recommendations in individuals with implantable cardiac electronic devices

normative_assertions.notes: Underlying-disease recommendations are referenced but not inferred.

text_units.verbatim_text: It is recommended that individuals with implanted devices with/without resynchronization and underlying disease follow the recommendations pertaining to the underlying disease.

a substitute for disease-related recommendations
when these mandate sports restrictions

header_path: Exercise recommendations in individuals with implantable cardiac electronic devices

normative_assertions.notes: ICD non-substitution instruction.
source_trigger_texts: is not recommended as a substitute

text_units.verbatim_text: An ICD is not recommended as a substitute for disease-related recommendations when these mandate sports restrictions.

entities.surface_form: Participation in regular moderate exercise
all individuals with CHD

header_path: Recommendations for patients with congenital heart disease

normative_assertions.notes: Moderate-exercise recommendation.

text_units.verbatim_text: Participation in regular moderate exercise is recommended in all individuals with CHD.

entities.surface_form: A discussion on exercise participation
provision of an individualized exercise prescription
every CHD patient encounter

header_path: Recommendations for patients with congenital heart disease

normative_assertions.notes: Discussion is represented as counselling.
Provision of the individualized prescription is a separate action.

text_units.verbatim_text: A discussion on exercise participation and provision of an individualized exercise prescription is recommended at every CHD patient encounter.

entities.surface_form: Competitive sport
individuals with CHD who are in NYHA class III–IV or with potentially serious arrhythmias

header_path: Recommendations for patients with congenital heart disease

normative_assertions.notes: Alternative NYHA or arrhythmia criteria are retained.

text_units.verbatim_text: Competitive sport is not recommended for individuals with CHD who are in NYHA class III–IV or with potentially serious arrhythmias.

entities.surface_form: pregnant women without medical or obstetric contraindications
participation in at least 150 min/week of moderate-intensity aerobic exercise before, during, and after pregnancy

normative_assertions.notes: Contraindication boundary and pregnancy timing are retained.

text_units.verbatim_text: Among pregnant women without medical or obstetric contraindications, participation in at least 150 min/week of moderate-intensity aerobic exercise before, during, and after pregnancy is recommended.

entities.surface_form: Re-evaluation before continuing exercise or training
pregnant woman if they experience excessive shortness of breath, severe chest pain, dizziness or syncope, regular painful contractions, vaginal bleeding, or amniotic fluid leakage

normative_assertions.notes: All symptom and obstetric triggers are retained.

text_units.verbatim_text: Re-evaluation before continuing exercise or training is recommended in pregnant woman if they experience excessive shortness of breath, severe chest pain, dizziness or syncope, regular painful contractions, vaginal bleeding, or amniotic fluid leakage.

entities.surface_form: women with CVD who were habitually engaged in strength training or power sport disciplines before pregnancy
discussing the option with the medical team before continuing
avoiding the Valsalva manoeuvre

normative_assertions.notes: Medical-team discussion is a distinct action.
Valsalva avoidance is a distinct against action.

text_units.verbatim_text: Among women with CVD who were habitually engaged in strength training or power sport disciplines before pregnancy, discussing the option with the medical team before continuing and avoiding the Valsalva manoeuvre is recommended.

entities.surface_form: Exercise or sport involving forceful physical contact, risk of falling or abdominal trauma, heavy lifting, scuba diving, or exercising at high altitude when unacclimatized

normative_assertions.notes: All listed exercise and sport hazards are preserved.

text_units.verbatim_text: Exercise or sport involving forceful physical contact, risk of falling or abdominal trauma, heavy lifting, scuba diving, or exercising at high altitude when unacclimatized are not recommended.
